import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.barplot(x=top_breeds.values, y=top_breeds.index, palette='viridis', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_data = df['AlterVHundNum'].dropna()

ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.axvline(age_data.median(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Median: {age_data.median():.1f} years')
ax2.legend(fontsize=10)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)

district_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax3, color=colors, edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Owner Age vs Dog Gender Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create a crosstab for owner age and dog gender
owner_age_dog_gender = pd.crosstab(df['AlterV10Lang'], df['SexHundLang'], normalize='index') * 100
owner_age_sorted = df[['AlterV10Lang', 'AlterV10Sort']].drop_duplicates().sort_values('AlterV10Sort')

owner_age_dog_gender = owner_age_dog_gender.reindex(owner_age_order)
owner_age_dog_gender.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
